# Test fixtures

Synthetic results in each tool's output_schema shape (GET /v1/tools/{id}), made up for tests.
They are not recordings of real searches, and their prices are not real.

| File | Tool |
|---|---|
| `google-flights.json` | Google Flights one-way, `tool_e3257cb40c2388c5523aca87d093a091` |
| `google-flights-round-trip.json` | Google Flights round trip, `tool_6a3b3272e28d38bf72801b7437fd0eee` |
| `american-award.json` | American one-way awards, `tool_65883b0821eef8fd9b9ad0c1c76384d1` |
| `american-award-round-trip.json` | American round-trip awards, `tool_77468f645784ce7a02e37f99b4fd8566` |
| `delta-award.json` | Delta one-way awards, `tool_8c892f491604a217ca39a4463644ec07` |
| `delta-award-round-trip.json` | Delta round-trip awards, `tool_2721b4ebfbaea5c91f5fa2fea4beebfc` |
| `united-award.json` | United one-way awards, `tool_ed898545b7c88650847580ad55f3d001` |
